### heatmap

```{r}
# Canonical markers from paper (canonical_paper)
canonical_markers <- c(
  "CD3D", "CD3G", "CD4", "CD8A", "IL7R",
  "NKG7", "GZMB", "GNLY", "KLRF1",
  "ALB", "APOE", "ALDOB",
  "CD68", "CD163", "C1QC",
  "CD1C", "FCN1", "LYZ",
  "VWF", "EMCN", "CD34",
  "CD79A", "MS4A1", "IGHM",
  "CSF3R", "S100A8", "S100A9",
  "MYH11", "NOTCH3", "RGS5",
  "CLDN4", "CLDN10", "CXCL6",
  "MKI67", "UBE2C",
  "CD14"
)

valid_markers <- intersect(canonical_markers, rownames(combined))

celltype_order <- c(
  "T cell",
  "NK cell",
  "Hepatocyte",
  "Macrophage",
  "cDC",
  "pDC",
  "Endothelial cell",
  "B cell",
  "Neutrophil",
  "HSC",
  "Cholangiocyte",
  "Plasma cell",
  "Monocyte",
  "Mast cell"
)

combined$my_annotation <- factor(
  combined$my_annotation,
  levels = intersect(celltype_order, unique(as.character(combined$my_annotation)))
)

#Scale markers
Idents(combined) <- "my_annotation"
combined <- ScaleData(combined, features = valid_markers)

p_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(
  combined,
  features = valid_markers,
  group.by = "my_annotation",
  disp.min = -2.5,
  disp.max = 2.5,
  slot = "scale.data",
  label = FALSE
) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#e0e0e0",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Expression"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, face = "italic", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave("../results/pictures/Fig 1C.png",
       p_heatmap, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

### bar chart
```{r}
#### Bar chart cell composition
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

celltype_order <- c(   
  "T cell",
  "cDC",
  "pDC",
  "NK cell",
  "Endothelial cell",
  "Macrophage",
  "Hepatocyte",
  "B cell",
  "Neutrophil",
  "HSC",
  "Cholangiocyte",
  "Plasma cell",
  "Monocyte",
  "Mast cell"
)

plot_data <- as.data.frame(combined@meta.data) %>%
  select(condition, my_annotation) %>%
  filter(!is.na(condition) & !is.na(my_annotation)) %>%
  
  count(condition, my_annotation, name = "count") %>%
  
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(percent = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  mutate(
    # Đảo ngược order_celltype
    my_annotation = factor(my_annotation, levels = celltype_order),
    condition = as.character(condition),
    condition = ifelse(condition == "cirrhosis", "Cirrhosis", condition),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Cirrhosis", "HCC", "HBV")) 
  )

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = condition, y = percent, fill = my_annotation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = FALSE)) +
  
  labs(x = "Group", y = "Proportion", fill = "Cell type") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 2)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 6)),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1) 
  ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  )
ggsave("../results/pictures/Fig 1D.png", p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

### box plot
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggplot2)

celltype_order <- c(  
  "B cell",
  "Cholangiocyte",
  "cDC",
  "pDC",
  "Endothelial cell",
  "HSC",
  "Hepatocyte",  
  "Macrophage",
  "Monocyte",  
  "Neutrophil",
  "NK cell",
  "Plasma cell",
  "T cell",
  "Mast cell"
)

plot_data <- as.data.frame(combined@meta.data) %>%
  select(condition, my_annotation, sample_id) %>%
  count(sample_id, condition, my_annotation, name = "n_cell") %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  mutate(percent = n_cell / sum(n_cell) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(
    my_annotation = factor(my_annotation, levels = celltype_order),
    condition = as.character(condition),
    condition = ifelse(condition == "cirrhosis", "Cirrhosis", condition),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Cirrhosis", "HCC", "HBV")) 
  )

n_celltype <- length(levels(plot_data$my_annotation))

my_comparisons <- list(
  c("HBV", "Cirrhosis"),
  c("Cirrhosis", "HCC"),
  c("HBV", "HCC")
)

## no adjust
# stat.test <- plot_data %>%
#   group_by(my_annotation) %>%
#   pairwise_wilcox_test(
#     percent ~ condition,
#     comparisons = my_comparisons,
#     p.adjust.method = "none"
#   ) %>%
#   add_significance("p") %>%
#   add_xy_position(x = "my_annotation", dodge = 0.8)

stat.test <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(my_annotation) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    percent ~ condition,
    comparisons = my_comparisons,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position( x = "my_annotation", dodge = 0.8)


stat.test <- stat.test %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = case_when(
      (group1 == "HBV" & group2 == "Cirrhosis") | (group1 == "Cirrhosis" & group2 == "HBV") ~ 87,
      (group1 == "Cirrhosis" & group2 == "HCC") | (group1 == "HCC" & group2 == "Cirrhosis") ~ 92,
      (group1 == "HBV" & group2 == "HCC")       | (group1 == "HCC" & group2 == "HBV")       ~ 97
    )
  )

box <- ggboxplot(
  plot_data,
  x = "my_annotation",
  y = "percent",
  color = "condition",
  fill = "white",                 # Đặt fill = "white" để ruột boxplot che hoàn toàn đường kẻ
  palette = c("#F8766D", "#00BA38", "#619CFF"),
  width = 0.6,
  outlier.size = 1.1,
  xlab = "Cell type",
  ylab = "Percentage (%)",
  title = "Boxplots of Percentages by Cell Type"
)

# ---  geom_vline làm lớp nền ---
box$layers <- c(
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.vector(
      sapply(1:n_celltype, function(x) c(x - 0.27, x + 0.27))
    ),
    color = "grey92",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ),
  box$layers 
)

box <- box +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "p.adj.signif", #label = "p.signif",
    hide.ns = FALSE,
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.linewidth = 0.4,
    label.size = 3.5
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75)) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "plain"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    
    # Tắt grid mặc định của theme để tránh chồng chéo với geom_vline
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5), 
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(color = "Group")

print(box)

ggsave("../results/pictures/Fig 1E.png", box, width = 12.8, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
```
